reviews.text:
I scheduled a groom here today at this location for the first time. I usually take my Shih Tzu to Dawn D in Schaumburg but we moved. I scheduled with Miranda and I do not recommend her, she does not know how to handle dogs, she does not have experience, she is also unprofessional.

I scheduled my dog for a full bath, haircut, teeth brushing , and flea / tick treatment.

When I arrived I confirmed the services. She comes out with the leash to transfer him from his harness.  She was extremely rough with my dog and unsympathetic when she was choking him with the leash saying he was being dramatic and choking himself.  So because she doesn’t know how to properly handle dogs it’s my Shih Tzus fault?

Ive never had a groomer behave like her so I asked her if she had much experience she got an attitude and responded “yes.” Without elaborating further. Which lets me know she does not.

I didn’t feel like she was a good match with my dog so I told her she would not be grooming him.

She was clearly mad, and when I asked if another groomer could take a look at my dog she rudely asked the other groomers “anybody wanna take a look at that dog” in very rude very unprofessional tone.

The second groomer was way more professional and gentle. I wouldn’t book Miranda ever again or let her ever groom my dog based on how tough she was with him in the hand off & how unprofessional she was.  I will also be calling corporate this rubbed me the wrong way I don’t trust her with any animal.
Very difficult to find out store waste of time
The lack of navigation to Petsmart's free parking area resulted in me paying extra for parking.
Thank you for leaving feedback. Please reach out to us at (312) 588-0138 so we may identify ways to improve your experience.

Started using Petsmart because petco gave my dog fleas, and now the same thing just happened from Friday and I called in Tuesday, to them it was too late like how many days does it take for dogs to start itching for fleas,🙄 if you love seeing your dog itchy bad, take your dog here for bath, but for me it’s break my heart so… I’m out …

I would not even rate one star for them the require something minus we took our dog for grooming and a stylist name jual was the guy the treatment with dog was way to rude and wasnt holding the dog properly and than when we asked to show the dog after grooming he was way to rude to us and asked us to step out and we spoke to the manger he said that he has done the same rude treatment to few other customers the same day i dont know if he himself would treat him as a customer would he even do that i would recommend no customer to ever get a grooming service here for ur pet
Thank you for leaving feedback. Please reach out to us at (312) 588-0138 so we may identify ways to improve your experience.
Got what I needed but service could be better . Might as well have a self service kiosk for checkout .

On yesterday we took our dog to be groomed and she was not matted might I add!!!! Upon arrival our Golden Doddle was Scalped and it was a VERY TERRIBLE JOB!!!!! The person who rendered the service was gone for the evening!!!!!!! Do Not take your dog there to be groomed!!!!! My amazing dog looks TERRIBLE and I am TRAUMATIZED and so is my son because this is his comfort animal!!!!!

I decided to write a review today randomly and I must say, some of these one star reviews were possible indicators of someone having a  bad day. Whether that be the staff of the reviewers.

I had a great experience with Ingrid today, but there was a Raymond there and several others that are proactive and helpful. Nevertheless, you can get solid clearance items and their store operates well. Accessible parking and there's rarely a line!

am writing to formally express my dissatisfaction with an incident that occurred at your South Gate Market location in Chicago (1101 S Canal St) on April 25, 2026, at approximately 12:05 PM.
Upon checking out at near register 3, I encountered a staff member whose behavior was not only unprofessional but also discourteous. My dog was securely leashed, as per store policy, yet I was confronted by the cashier who insisted that my dog was not on a leash. This accusation was made bluntly without a polite inquiry or even the basic courtesy of a 'please.'
Despite the clear visibility of the leash, there was no apology forthcoming from the staff member once the mistake was recognized. Instead, the situation escalated needlessly when the cashier deliberately obstructed my passage. When I politely requested to pass by saying "excuse me," I was met with a disdainful look, and only then did the cashier move. Such behavior is unacceptable and tarnishes the friendly and customer-centric image that PetSmart professes to uphold. It is disheartening to experience this level of service, especially from a brand that we trust with the care and supplies for our beloved pets.
I am compelled to inform you that due to this incident, I am reconsidering my patronage at PetSmart and will be discussing this matter with the store manager as well. I believe that corrective action should be taken to prevent similar incidents in the future, and I hope that this issue is addressed promptly.
Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to your prompt response and a resolution that upholds the high standards of customer service and respect that PetSmart is known for.
Toni in the grooming department, highly unprofessional, very Rude will not be ever booking with her at least

Arrived 10 mins early with my two Shih Tzus for a 9 am grooming appointment. The associate, Miranda, was literally sitting there not doing anything and made me wait the 10 minutes inexplicably without assisting. I’ve had dogs for years and they have always been accommodating and more than willing to take the dogs.

I recently picked up a few essentials from PetSmart, and overall it was a smooth experience. The store was clean and well-organized, which made it easy to find what I needed without wandering around too much. A staff member even helped me choose a better food option for my pet, which I appreciated. Checkout was quick, though the line got a bit long during peak hours. Prices are a little higher than some online options, but the convenience and in-store support make up for it. Overall, a reliable place for pet supplies.
Hi, thanks for giving us so many stars!

This place will con you out of your money. I took my dog here twice. He was completely new to hair cuts and needed someone with patience. Each time they were unable to cut his hair but charged me full price over $70 each time even though they did not get the job done and blamed it on him not being ready. I took him to a different location and they took their time with him and said he did really well and gave him a really good cut!
The staff are very friendly. I love going to this place for my pets' food. 🐕‍🦺🐕‍🦺 …
Hi, we love receiving a high rating, and appreciate your positive review! We hope you'll consider us again in the future!
Eva did an amazing job on my fur baby . I know he can be a handful and she was very patient with him. She is the best groomer

Super hard to find, especially if you're on foot. They really need better signage for pedestrians and people taking public transport. This is the closest one to downtown so they have to know that not everyone is going to drive to their store. Plenty of people rely on public transport and foot, and there's absolutely no signs.
So many stars! We're happy to have earned it!

my experience every time I go to PetSmart on Roosevelt and Canal is that they have excellent customer service And someone is always around to help you with an item if you can’t find it yourself and I really love the Groomers. They ask you questions about your dog or habits and everything. They really want to get to know their client so I do give it five stars because they truly do deserve it and I want to thank ERICA my groomer because she does a magnificent job on my Pomeranian Lovie. Thank you.
I had my dog groomed here and the last two times she was wet and hair was pasted on her torso. Do not have your dog groomed here.
Fabulous Customer Service. Really helpful staff. Was shopping fr my kitty’s.

I made arrangements 30 days in advance for my pets stay, day of my trip, went to drop off my fur babies because the girls were too timid to handle pets. If a pet meets you the first time there will be some apprehension, they wouldn't even give the babies a chance. Told us after 5 minutes they couldn't board our pets. A 6 lb Yorkie whose bark is bigger than his nip. And a cat, open the cage and let him walk into the kitty cottage on his own until he got ready to socialize. I have a suggestion if you want to board new pets, maybe have a meet and greet first. My Xmas trip was cancelled I'm heartbroken
Very clean, easy parking, easy to find what I needed. Love that they have 2 rescue partners they work with.

This store is disgusting. I have mentioned this almost every time I come in here to a manager. It’s the closest one to me - is why I come in for grooming mostly. Today someone knowingly left crap on the floor and put a “caution sign” over it vs. picking it up. That’s not only potentially a health hazard but HAVE SOME PRIDE. Literally, every other PetSmart I’ve ever been in is better than this one. I’m gonna have to rethink my pet supplies and needs. I’m over it.
So disappointed! I took my dog to get groomed (wash and nail trim). When we got back home and looked at her nails they were awful! They were broken and one was still bleeding...

Had a terrible experience here when i came to get my puppy groomed. My groomer was 30 minutes late and spent over 5 hours  on my puppy. My puppy was waiting and unable to eat this entire time. Mind you, I asked for a very basic grooming package that should never take close to 3 hours never mind 5 hours.

The grooming staff never gave any update on my puppy or that it would take over 2 hours past the maximum allotted time for the service. When I got to the store after 3 hours I was told it would take one more hour but ended up taking 2 more. I spoke to the manager and she offered me a 20% discount which is nice but realistically she should have made this service free if she really felt bad. I also want to note I never asked for a financial refund. I also informed her that her groomers were on their personal phones and provided her with a photo of it as proof. How is it possible to not only be so far behind on schedule and still have time to be on your personal phones doing no work while some puppies have been there for nearly 5 hours at that point? It’s absolutely disgusting.

When I finally got my puppy his tail was not even touched but at that point I just wanted to leave. I am not sure where the root to the problem is but something needs to change. I simply hope this doesn’t happen to another puppy because over 5 hours for a basic grooming service is borderline animal cruelty.

One of the managers is really nice forgot his name. White guy with the blacks glasses usually in the evenings.  Always very helpful and kind when I go there. FISH from this specific store end to actually survive in my tank. I think its because they actually take care of their tanks unlike other stores like the petco down the street.

This is for their adoption center. Ridiculous to not hold a dog for someone to drive 2 hours to meet it… but to say if it’s not available others are. I guess it’s not about finding the right home but the fastest  home!
The Everyday Adoption Center at this PetSmart is awesome. Stop in and find your new forever family member!!
The price matched online sale price!
Always lots of pee accidents, but signage to go around

Took my dog to grooming, had kennel cough right afterwards, had to visit three different vets and spending thousands, the most important thing is my boy suffered so much. Never will I bring my dog to a petsmart again
The staff at the checkout are really nice. Never had a bad experience.

Something’s changed for the better.. I’ve been going here for my dogs grooming for about 5 years. The service is always okay but now it’s amazing. I called last minute last week to make an appointment and while they were able to squeeze me in, I didn’t have updated shots.

The woman on the phone was so understanding and even informed me of a low-cost clinic available at the store the next day.

When I rescheduled a few days later. Isak (sp) honestly gave the best groom I’ve seen on my girl in quite a while. I almost feel bad for allowing the prior haircuts. Please keep the team you have now!! Especially Isak!!!!

Underserved and overpriced. This was my first time booking an appointment for grooming for my cat. As I arrived and was met at the front counter for my cat's turn, we chose the #5 trim. Our showed us what the previous customers would choose for their cat's trim, which was the LION CUT. (Name of the groomer will not be named for privacy) There was no initial agreement for OUR cat to receive that specific trim as the discussion was about what OTHER customers would usually choose. The price was set at $113 and was expecting the trim to be the entire body but since there was miscommunication, this resulted in a lion cut. I thought things weren't bewildering enough. I came back home and noticed that near my cat's GENITAL area was shaved, exposing the SKIN. The amount of fur that was shaved from the genital to almost the bottom of his stomach area was about 4-5 inches. This was NOT discussed and was NOT consented. All that was discussed was the price, cuts customers usually choose for THEIR cats, signature, what my cat is familiar with when coming to grooming, and how the service would be stopped if there was anything apposing as stress for my cat. Something that was also discussed was how the trim would result in uneven trims. The fur was not uneven, it was BOTCHED. Again, I am still SO confused on how we discussed the #5 trim on the cat, but somehow my cat's genital area to his stomach basically was honestly trimmed like a #10... And where his upper stomach wasn't even TOUCHED. To make it worse, its wasn't even a #10, it was just exposing his entire skin at this point. I would never book an appointment here again. Sad thing is, my money cannot be refunded and from the other reviews, it seems like they have the same experience. FUNNY ENOUGH THE OWNER ONLY RESPONDS AND APPLAUDS 4-5 REVIEWS INSTEAD OF TAKING THE CONSIDERATION OF THE CUSTOMERS WITH LOWER RATINGS... As I mentioned, this is why it was underserved and overpriced. If you think about bringing any pet for grooming, don't, what a joke.
